mia: @here quick update from canary for v3.2-q (nf4-int8) — pushed at 09:42 PT to 1% traffic. Early metrics look mixed.
jon: tl;dr?
mia: - token cost ~ -12% (est)
mia: - p95 latency +8ms
mia: - eval helpfulness (dataset A) -1.8pp absolute
mia: Canary gating flagged `quality_regression` on the answers_accuracy slice.
jon: do we have per-slice diffs yet?
rachel: running slice-wide eval now, should have CSV in ~15m
eval-bot: automated-eval summary: overall_pass 97.2% -> 95.4%. critical_slices: long_context (-2.4pp), numeric_reasoning (-1.9pp).
kevin: proposal: hold promotion. tighten auto-fallback threshold from 1.5pp -> 1.0pp abs on any critical slice, and reduce canary to 0.2% for triage.
ops-bot: action: holding rollout; routing for model:v3.2-q set to 0.2% (manual). alert rule adjusted: slice_delta_alert if >0.8pp.
mia: sharing quick failing example where output drops on long context.
mia: ```
input: [long prior conversation omitted for brevity]
expected: cites earlier paragraph and carries context
actual: brief generic reply, misses previous ref
```
rachel: looks like kv-cache alignment issue in the quantized path — index rounding plausible.
jon: can we reproduce in local nf4-int8 smoke harness? include seed and sample config.
kevin: starting local reproduce now. I can also run a shadow compare against v3.2-fp16.
mia: decision: keep candidate traffic at 0.2%, no auto-promote. If quality delta doesn't recover within 24h, auto-fallback to v3.1-stable and create an incident ticket + postmortem.
rachel: adding notes to rollout runbook and will attach eval diffs when ready.
mia: :white_check_mark: thanks team.
jon: :eyes: ping me if you need infra access or longer-range profiling.
